actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.ChatScreenServices.get#RoomView').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', aroundSeq: aroundSeq ? Number(limit) : 50}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {room: out.room, member: out.member, access: out.access, memberList: out.memberList, timeline: out.timeline})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.ChatScreenServices.get#RoomView').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', limit: 1}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {room: out.room, member: out.member, access: out.access, memberList: out.memberList})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatServices.find#RoomReactions').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', reactionKey: reactionKey || null, onlyToMe: String(onlyToMe) === 'true', limit: limit ? Number(limit) : 40, beforeReactionSeq: beforeReactionSeq ? Number(beforeReactionSeq) : null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {messages: out.messages, nextBeforeReactionSeq: out.nextBeforeReactionSeq})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatServices.find#ChatActivity').parameters({ kinds: String(kinds || '').split(',').map((part) => part.trim()).filter((part) => part), limit: limit ? Number(limit) : 40, cursor: cursor || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {items: out.items, nextCursor: out.nextCursor})
const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.ChatScreenServices.find#DirectChatMail').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {mailList: out.mailList})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatServices.find#RoomThreads').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', limit: limit ? Number(limit) : 20, beforeDate: beforeDate ? Number(beforeDate) : null, beforeEventSeq: beforeEventSeq ? Number(beforeEventSeq) : null, mine: String(mine) === 'true'}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {threadList: out.threadList, hasMore: out.hasMore, nextBeforeDate: out.nextBeforeDate ?? null, nextBeforeEventSeq: out.nextBeforeEventSeq ?? null})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.ChatScreenServices.find#MentionUsers').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', term: term || ''}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? [] : (out.userList || []))

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatBridgeServices.retry#Delivery').parameter('chatBridgeDeliveryId', chatBridgeDeliveryId || '').requireNewTransaction(true).call() const errors = ec.message.hasError() ? ec.message.errorsString : null ec.message.clearErrors() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(errors ? {reasonCode: out?.reasonCode || 'refused', error: errors} : {retried: true})

ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatServices.pin#Message').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', eventSeq: Number(eventSeq || 0), pinned: String(pinned) !== 'false'}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({})

let options = [] try { options = JSON.parse(optionsJson || '[]') } catch (err) { options = [] } const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatServices.create#Poll').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', question: question || '', optionList: Array.isArray(options) ? options.map((option) => String(option ?? '')) : [], anonymous: String(anonymous) === 'true', multiple: String(multiple) === 'true', closesDate: closesDate ? Number(closesDate) : null, threadRootEventSeq: threadRootEventSeq ? Number(threadRootEventSeq) : null, clientRef: clientRef || null, roomUrl: (System.getProperty('comms_app_root') || '/qapps/BasicComms') + '/Chat?chatRoomId=' + encodeURIComponent(chatRoomId || '')}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {eventSeq: out.eventSeq, event: out.event, clientRef: clientRef || null})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatServices.close#Poll').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', eventSeq: Number(eventSeq || 0)}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {poll: out.poll})

let rich = null try { rich = JSON.parse(richJson || 'null') } catch (err) { rich = null } const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatRichServices.send#Rich').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', rich: rich && typeof rich === 'object' ? rich : {}, chatAttachmentIdList: attachmentIds ? String(attachmentIds).split(',').map((id) => id.trim()).filter((id) => id) : [], threadRootEventSeq: threadRootEventSeq ? Number(threadRootEventSeq) : null, clientRef: clientRef || null, roomUrl: (System.getProperty('comms_app_root') || '/qapps/BasicComms') + '/Chat?chatRoomId=' + encodeURIComponent(chatRoomId || '')}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {reasonCode: out.reasonCode || null} : {eventSeq: out.eventSeq, event: out.event, clientRef: clientRef || null})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatRichServices.reply#Suggestion').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', eventSeq: Number(eventSeq || 0), index: Number(index || 0), cardIndex: cardIndex !== null && cardIndex !== undefined && cardIndex !== '' ? Number(cardIndex) : null, clientRef: clientRef || null, roomUrl: (System.getProperty('comms_app_root') || '/qapps/BasicComms') + '/Chat?chatRoomId=' + encodeURIComponent(chatRoomId || '')}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {reasonCode: out.reasonCode || null} : {eventSeq: out.eventSeq, event: out.event, clientRef: clientRef || null})
ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatServices.remove#LinkPreviews').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', eventSeq: Number(eventSeq || 0)}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({})
const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatServices.mark#AllRead').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {roomCount: out.roomCount})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.ChatScreenServices.upload#ChatFiles').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', file: file || null, uploadId: uploadId || null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {uploadList: out.uploadList, failedList: out.failedList, messageInfos: (out.failedList || []).map((failed) => ({type: 'warning', message: failed.fileName + ': ' + failed.error}))})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.ChatScreenServices.lookup#Records').parameters({operation: 'search', text: term || ''}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? [] : (out.optionList || []))

const flag = (value) => value === true || value === 'true' || value === 'Y' ? true : value === false || value === 'false' || value === 'N' ? false : null const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.ChatScreenServices.create#ChatRoom').parameters({roomTypeEnumId: roomTypeEnumId || 'private', roomName: roomName || null, topic: topic || null, memberUserIds: memberUserIds || null, encrypted: flag(encrypted)}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {chatRoomId: out.chatRoomId, created: out.created, encrypted: !!out.encrypted})

const sealed = encrypted === true || encrypted === 'true' || encrypted === 'Y' ? true : encrypted === false || encrypted === 'false' || encrypted === 'N' ? false : null const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.ChatScreenServices.create#ChatRoom').parameters({roomTypeEnumId: 'direct', memberUserIds: userIds || null, encrypted: sealed}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {chatRoomId: out.chatRoomId, created: out.created, encrypted: !!out.encrypted})

ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.ChatScreenServices.join#ChatRoom').parameter('chatRoomId', chatRoomId || '').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.l10n.localize('Joined')}]})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatBlockServices.block#Room').parameter('chatRoomId', chatRoomId || '').call() || {} ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {blocked: out.blocked, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.l10n.localize('Blocked')}]})

ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatBlockServices.unblock#Room').parameter('chatRoomId', chatRoomId || '').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.l10n.localize('Unblocked')}]})

ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.call.SmsSpamServices.mark#NotSpam').parameter('chatRoomId', chatRoomId || '').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.l10n.localize('Moved out of Spam')}]})

const numbers = phoneNumbers ? String(phoneNumbers).split(',').map((number) => number.trim()).filter((number) => number) : [] ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.call.SmsSpamServices.report#Spam').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', phoneNumberList: numbers}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.l10n.localize('Reported as spam and blocked')}]})

ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatBlockServices.block#ChatUser').parameter('blockedUserId', userId || '').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.l10n.localize('Blocked')}]})

ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatBlockServices.unblock#ChatUser').parameter('blockedUserId', userId || '').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.l10n.localize('Unblocked')}]})
ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatServices.remove#Member').parameter('chatRoomId', chatRoomId || '').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({})
ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatServices.set#MemberRole').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', userId: userId || '', roleEnumId: roleEnumId || ''}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({})

ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatServices.update#Room').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', roomName: roomName != null ? roomName : null, topic: topic != null ? topic : null, visibilityEnumId: visibilityEnumId || null, archived: archived === 'true' ? true : (archived === 'false' ? false : null)}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.l10n.localize('Saved')}]})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatBridgeServices.store#RoomBridge').parameters({chatRoomBridgeId: chatRoomBridgeId || null, chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', chatBridgeId: chatBridgeId || null, externalRoomId: externalRoomId || null, externalRoomName: externalRoomName || null, externalRoomUrl: externalRoomUrl || null, directionEnumId: directionEnumId || null}) .requireNewTransaction(true).disableAuthz().call() || {} const errors = ec.message.hasError() ? ec.message.errorsString : null ec.message.clearErrors() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({reasonCode: out.reasonCode || null, errors, chatRoomBridgeId: out.chatRoomBridgeId || null})

ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatBridgeServices.end#RoomBridge').parameter('chatRoomBridgeId', chatRoomBridgeId || '') .requireNewTransaction(true).disableAuthz().call() const errors = ec.message.hasError() ? ec.message.errorsString : null ec.message.clearErrors() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({errors})
